Arcant is possibly, as Ludwig thinks, the name of the author of a hymn of the Rigveda ; but the word may be merely the ordinary participle ‘praising.’
Foot notes Translation of the Ṛigveda, 3, 133.
x. 149, 5.

Arcanānas.--In one passage of the Rigveda the gods MitraVaruṇa are besought to protect arcanānas. He is also invoked with śyāvāśva and several other ancestors enumerated in the Atharvaveda. He appears as father of śyāvāśva in the pañcaviṃśa brāhmaṇa. The later tradition makes him play a part in the legend of his son's wedding, which Sieg endeavours to show is known to the Rigveda.
Foot notes v. 64, 7.
